तुवर तुवर, अस्, आ, अम्, astringent; beard-
less; (अस्, अम्), m. n. an astringent taste; (अस्),
m. a sort of grain, = तुवर-यावनाल; (ई), f. =
आढकी, a kind of lentil, Cajanus Indicus; a fragrant
[]
earth; alum; [cf. तूवर.]
—तुवर-यावनाल,
अस्, m. a sort of grain, = कषाय-यावनाल, &c.
—तुवरी-शिम्ब, अस्, m. a kind of plant, Cassia
Tora, = चक्र-मर्दक.

तूवर तूवर, अस्, आ, अम्, = तुवर, astrin-
gent; (अस्), m. an astringent taste; a bull without
horns [cf. तूपर] though of an age to have them;
a beardless man; a eunuch; (ई), f. a fragrant earth,
= तुवरी.

तुवरक, अस्, m. a sort of grain (?); N. of a tree
growing in the countries bordering on the western
ocean; (इका), f. Cajanus Indicus; a sort of earth;
alum.

तूवरक, अस्, आ, अम्, unmanly; a eunuch; (used
as a taunt or abusive epithet.)

तुवि तुवि (fr. rt. 2. तु), = बहु, much, many,
great, strong, excessive, very, (only used in the Ved.
compounds enumerated below); (इस्), f. = तुम्बी, a
long gourd.
—तुवि-कूर्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, or तुवि-कूर्मिन्,
ई, इणी, इ, Ved. powerful in working, efficacious; (Sāy.)
doing many and various deeds; epithet of Indra.
—तु-
वि-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. of a strong will; (Sāy.) doing
many deeds; having much knowledge; epithet of
Indra.
—तुवि-क्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. epithet of Indra's
bow, (according to Sāy. and the Nirukta = बहु-वि-
क्षेप or महा-विक्षेप), ‘throwing far,’ perhaps
‘very destructive,’ (क्ष being then fr. rt. 4. क्षि.)
—तुवि-क्षत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ruling powerfully,
(according to Mahī-dhara) preserving from many inju-
ries, epithet of Aditi.
—तुवि-ग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
swallowing much; (Sāy.) sounding loudly; going
quickly.
—तुवि-ग्राभ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. seizing
powerfully.
—तुवि-ग्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. swallowing
much or greedily; (Sāy.) having a full throat or to
be praised by many.
—तुवि-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
having a powerful or firm or erect neck, having
many throats, swallowing or consuming much, all-
embracing.
—तुवि-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of strong
or powerful nature, powerful; born for many,
born for the protection of many; (Sāy.) born
with many (qualities), from whom many are
born; epithet of the gods Indra, Varuṇa, Varuṇa-
Mitra, &c.
—तुवि-देष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. granting
excellent gifts, epithet of Indra; (Sāy.) giving much.
—तुवि-द्युम्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very glorious,
powerful, wealthy; epithet of Indra, and of the
Maruts.
—तुवि-नृम्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very
manly or valiant or courageous; epithet of Indra.
—तुवि-प्रति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (Sāy.) visiting many,
approaching many; withstanding many, (perhaps
rather) resisting powerfully; [cf. अ-प्रति.]
—तुवि-
बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. killing many.
—तुवि-
ब्रह्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. very devoted or pious.
—तुवि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. very zealous, very
furious.
—तुवि-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making or
creating much, very efficacious, measuring many (?).
—तुवि-म्रक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. injuring greatly,
destructive; (Sāy.) destroying much (timber).
—तुवि-
राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. granting in abundance;
(Sāy.) opulent, having great wealth.
—तुवि-वाज,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having much food or strength,
strengthening, abounding with food.
—तुवि-शग्म,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. able to do much; (Sāy.) having
much enjoyment or pleasure.
—तुवि-शुष्म, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. high-spirited; (Sāy.) of great power,
very strong, epithet of Indra and of Indra-Varuṇa.
—तुवि-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. highly renowned,
having great fame.
—तुविश्रवस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्,
having very great fame, an epithet of Agni.
—तुविष्-
टम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strongest, most powerful,
most valid.
—तुविष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. power-
ful, mighty, efficacious.
—तुवि-ष्वणस् (˚वि-स्व्˚),
आस्, आस्, अस्, or तुवि-ष्वणि, इस्, इस्, इ, or तुवि-ष्वन्,
आ, आ, अ, Ved. loud-sounding, roaring.
—तुवी-मघ,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. giving abundantly; (Sāy.) having
great riches, epithet of Indra, and of the Maruts.
—तुवी-रव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making a terrible
noise (in battle &c.).
—तुवी-रवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
making a great noise (?); (Sāy.) possessed of many
praisers, (either for तुवीरव-वत्, or रवान् may be
an irregular nom. case of the part. रवत्.)
—तुव्य्-
ओजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. very strong or powerful.
तूवरिका, f. = तुवरिका, a kind of earth.
